title: Allow installing unified .quadlets file from URL
body:
### Feature request description

When trying to install a .quadlets file from a URL, the error complains about the file extension:

```
podman quadlet install https://codeberg.org/gabeklavans/stereotypes/src/branch/main/stereotypes.quadlets
Error: quadlet "https://codeberg.org/gabeklavans/stereotypes/src/branch/main/stereotypes.quadlets" failed to install: ".quadlets" is not a supported Quadlet file type
Error: errors occurred installing some Quadlets
```

I would expect to be able to install from a URL pointing to a .quadlets file the same way that I can do so with a local file.

### Suggest potential solution

I believe the relevant code is around here:
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go#L128
where the handling of URLs is separate from the handling of .quadlets files.

I think a solution could be to refactor the code for checking and handling .quadlets files into a function that can be called after the temporary file is downloaded from a given URL, as well as being called in its current location.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

_No response_

### Additional context

To get the error message above I used this Podman version:

```
podman version
Client:        Podman Engine
Version:       5.8.7
API Version:   5.8.7
Go Version:    go1.26.8-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:    c593b672bf3db1173aebea565ebf1a724ea196dc
Built:         Wed Sep 16 08:00:00 2026
Build Origin:  Fedora Project
OS/Arch:       linux/amd64
```

But I believe the issue would still occur in the latest based on my understanding of the code I linked to.
